claim_scope.primary_question: Among eligible corpus-born Weekly levels active at the start of an eligible complete target week, what fraction are consumed during that target week?
claim_scope.population: all rows of the bound LEVEL_WEEK_OPPORTUNITY ledger

primary_estimand.numerator: sum_i Y_i across all eligible opportunity rows
primary_estimand.denominator: N = count of all eligible opportunity rows
primary_estimand.weighting: each eligible level-week opportunity has equal weight
primary_estimand.aggregation: ratio of total events to total opportunities, not mean of weekly rates

mandatory_counts.low_support_groups: must still be emitted; no post-result suppression

side_semantics.combined_justification: HIGH and LOW use the same level-week opportunity grain and same binary take semantics
side_semantics.anti_masking_rule: global pooled value may not replace or suppress HIGH and LOW reporting

dependence_model.reason: multiple active levels share the same market path and target-week realization

historical_fixed_corpus.rationale: for the realized bound historical corpus, numerator and denominator are observed quantities; a sampling CI is not used to imply a population beyond that corpus

process_generalization.resampling_unit: ordered target_week_id clusters; when a week is selected all its opportunity rows move together
process_generalization.replicate_statistic: ratio of summed swept_this_week numerators to summed opportunity denominators across resampled week blocks
process_generalization.stationarity_gate: if stationarity_status == UNRESOLVED_NONSTATIONARY then global resampling is forbidden
process_generalization.smf_runtime_compatibility_note: the adopted SMF M05 runtime qualifies moving-block resampling semantics for means; a ratio-of-sums cluster statistic requires its own frozen executable qualification before use
process_generalization.no_auto_fallback: IID bootstrap, naive binomial interval, or opportunity-row bootstrap may not be substituted

multiplicity_policy.interpretation: differences across preregistered cells are descriptive heterogeneity only
multiplicity_policy.later_inference: requires separate claim, activation, multiplicity contract and prospective/generalization boundary

timing_semantics.target_month_position: EARLY_01_15 vs LATE_16_EOM using target_week_id day
timing_semantics.level_age_band: derived from level_age_weeks before target outcome
timing_semantics.take_day_ny: EVENT-ONLY conditional distribution; not a denominator-defined pre-event occurrence context

forbidden: calculate real occurrence results under BEPD-03A
naive IID binomial inference over opportunity rows
infer future probability from historical rate
